REF_WHO_ILI.title: WHO Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System (GISRS) Case Definitions for ILI
REF_WHO_ILI.description: Standardized clinical case definition for influenza-like illness (ILI): acute respiratory infection with measured fever of >= 38 C and cough, with onset within the last 10 days.

REF_CDC_COLD.title: Common Colds: Protect Yourself and Others
REF_CDC_COLD.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
REF_CDC_COLD.description: Clinical overview of viral upper respiratory tract infections highlighting nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, sore throat, and mild cough typically in the absence of high fever.

REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.title: Allergic Rhinitis Practice Parameters
REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.organization: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI)
REF_AAAI_ALLERGY.description: Diagnostic indicators for allergic rhinitis: paroxysmal sneezing, clear rhinorrhea, nasal itching, itchy/watery eyes, absence of fever or infectious prodrome.

REF_IHS_MIGRAINE.title: International Classification of Headache Disorders (ICHD-3)
REF_IHS_MIGRAINE.description: Diagnostic criteria for migraine without aura: recurrent headache disorder manifesting in attacks lasting 4-72 hours, typically unilateral, pulsating, moderate or severe, aggravated by physical activity, accompanied by nausea/vomiting and/or photophobia and phonophobia.

REF_ACG_GASTRO.title: Clinical Guideline: Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prevention of Acute Diarrheal Infections in Adults
REF_ACG_GASTRO.description: Clinical pattern of acute infectious gastroenteritis presenting with acute onset of diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal cramping.

REF_EAU_UTI.title: EAU Guidelines on Urological Infections
REF_EAU_UTI.description: Clinical presentation of uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection (cystitis): dysuria, urinary frequency, urinary urgency, suprapubic tenderness in the absence of vaginal symptoms or systemic fever.

REF_EMERGENCY_RED_FLAGS.title: Emergency Medicine Clinical Practice Guidelines: Red Flag Symptom Recognition
REF_EMERGENCY_RED_FLAGS.description: Clinical triage indicators representing immediate potential threats to life or limb requiring urgent emergency medical evaluation.

REF_CDC_COVID.title: CDC Clinical Spectrum and Presentation of SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) Infection
REF_CDC_COVID.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
REF_CDC_COVID.description: Clinical presentation of acute COVID-19 infection highlighting fever, cough, fatigue, headache, and pathognomonic new loss of taste or smell.

REF_IDSA_STREP.title: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Group A Streptococcal Pharyngitis
REF_IDSA_STREP.description: Evidence-based Centor / McIsaac criteria for streptococcal pharyngitis: fever, tonsillar exudates, tender anterior cervical adenopathy, and absence of cough.

REF_AAO_SINUS.title: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis
REF_AAO_SINUS.organization: American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (AAO-HNS)
REF_AAO_SINUS.description: Diagnostic criteria for acute rhinosinusitis: purulent nasal drainage accompanied by nasal obstruction, facial pain-pressure-fullness, or both.

REF_CHEST_BRONCHITIS.title: CHEST Guideline: Management of Cough and Acute Bronchitis
REF_CHEST_BRONCHITIS.description: Clinical diagnosis of acute bronchitis characterized by acute cough with or without sputum production in the absence of pneumonia consolidation.

REF_GINA_ASTHMA.title: Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention
REF_GINA_ASTHMA.description: Symptom patterns characteristic of acute bronchospasm / asthma: wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and cough that vary over time and in intensity.

REF_IHS_TENSION.title: International Classification of Headache Disorders: Tension-Type Headache
REF_IHS_TENSION.description: Diagnostic criteria for tension-type headache: bilateral, pressing/tightening non-pulsating head pain of mild-to-moderate intensity, without nausea and with no more than one of photophobia or phonophobia.

REF_ACG_GERD.title: Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
REF_ACG_GERD.description: Hallmark clinical symptoms of GERD: heartburn (pyrosis) and acid regurgitation, frequently aggravated in the supine position or following meals.

REF_AAP_AOM.title: The Diagnosis and Management of Acute Otitis Media
REF_AAP_AOM.description: Clinical criteria for acute otitis media: rapid onset of ear pain (otalgia), ear fullness, and middle ear inflammation following upper respiratory infection.

REF_AAO_CONJUNCTIVITIS.title: Conjunctivitis Preferred Practice Pattern
REF_AAO_CONJUNCTIVITIS.description: Clinical features of acute allergic conjunctivitis: bilateral ocular itching, hyperemia (redness), watery discharge, and chemosis associated with environmental allergen exposure.

REF_IDSA_DIARRHEA.title: Clinical Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Infectious Diarrhea
REF_IDSA_DIARRHEA.description: Clinical identification of inflammatory/invasive bacterial diarrhea: fever, bloody stools (dysentery), severe abdominal cramps, and fecal urgency.
